articles.title: Quilt Hex Variety
articles.summary: Rounded hexagon cells in rows, each cell a different gloss and metal level, like a honeycomb of mixed finishes. Reads as a muted pastel honeycomb or patchwork mosaic; a regular tile rhythm in mixed soft colours with no dominant hue.
articles.what: Hexagonal tile material variety with each hex cell assigned different metallic property Up close: Brick-like rows of tall tapered hexagon cells, about 45 px wide by 70 px tall, each filled with a different washed pastel (green, purple, rose, grey, teal, brown, mustard) and edged with a thin pale line. Flat fills with a faint grain. From a distance: Reads as a muted pastel honeycomb or patchwork mosaic; a regular tile rhythm in mixed soft colours with no dominant hue. Measured spec (average): metal 153, roughness 34, coat 35. Shine: high gloss. Metal: medium. It takes the colour you give the zone.
when: Fits: gt / sports car, show car, truck / off-road.
how: Click the zone you want to change.
Click the BASE MATERIAL box (it says "Click to choose a base") and type "Quilt Hex Variety" in the SEARCH FINISHES box.
Click it to open the big preview, then click Apply.
Pick your colour with BASE COLOR.
Render and judge it on the car, not on the swatch.
tips: Hood, roof, sides: cells are big and regular, broad panels show the grid
Hex scale can look odd on tight curves, avoid bumpers and mirrors
Bold black or white numbers with a thick outline read; pastel numbers vanish into the cells.
Bold dark stripes or blocks: strong structure over the pastel cells
Pairs well with: matte black, gunmetal, white, neon accents.
pitfalls: Not a honeycomb of one colour: every cell is a different pastel
Not red: the render is a mixed pastel patchwork, the red palette is misleading
Avoid: hex scale can look odd on tight curves, numbers over cells.
articles.spec_character: Average spec: metal 153 (strong pearl or anodized metal), roughness 34 (high gloss), clearcoat 35 (strong-to-medium clearcoat). The spec is textured, not flat: metal vary by 20 or more across the surface.
articles.intent_note: Full-finish shelf: the finish carries both its own paint look and its own shine.
articles.paint_advice: Pearl depth shows best on a clear mid-tone or deep saturated colour; a dull grey paint hides the shift. Avoid: hex scale can look odd on tight curves, numbers over cells.

combos.why: Patterns that suit it: bold dark stripes or blocks: strong structure over the pastel cells; big simple graphics: the cells are large and regular
Patterns to avoid: other multi-colour or geometric patterns: clash; pinstripes: collide with the hex outlines
Spec overlays that work: gloss clearcoat: unifies the cells; matte band for numbers: calm patch
Judge the paint and the shine together: the same spec looks different under different colours.
